headline: Bishkek Advisory Operations
intro: Our central planning and traveler relations desk is located in Bishkek. Prior to reserving your journey, we host a 20-minute direct call to align your physical comfort, travel dates, and intellectual aspirations.

status_panel.title: Call Desk Status
status_panel.description: Svagato or a senior cultural specialist is available during Bishkek office hours to answer your questions.
status_panel.note: Pre-registration required for all voice calls.
